tabs.challenges.description: Tab at the top of the Leaderboard screen: the challenges running now, tasks that earn points.

tabs.kudos.description: Tab at the top of the Leaderboard screen: the rankings by kudos, the thank-yous members give for changes. "Kudos" is the feature's name.

tabs.standings.description: Tab at the top of the Leaderboard screen: the ranking of participants by points.

eventBar.label.description: Accessible name of the drop-down on the Leaderboard screen that chooses which event (a season or a competition within it) is shown.

eventBar.loading.description: Only option in the event drop-down on the Leaderboard screen while the list of events is being fetched.

eventBar.noEvents.description: Only option in the event drop-down on the Leaderboard screen when there is no event to choose.

eventBar.option.season.description: Option in the event drop-down on the Leaderboard screen: {{event}} is a season's name, and choosing it shows the whole season combined.

eventBar.option.current.description: Option in the event drop-down on the Leaderboard screen: {{event}} is the name of the event running now.

eventBar.option.past.description: Option in the event drop-down on the Leaderboard screen: {{event}} is the name of an event that has ended.

eventBar.noneSelected.description: Shown under the event drop-down on the Leaderboard screen when no event is chosen.

eventBar.loadFailed.description: Error shown under the event drop-down on the Leaderboard screen when the chosen event's details could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

eventBar.status.season.description: Small label beside the event's name on the Standings tab: the whole season is shown, not one event. Lower case.

eventBar.status.activeNow.description: Small label beside the event's name on the Standings tab: the event is running at this moment. Lower case.

eventBar.status.active.description: Small label beside the event's name on the Standings tab: the event is open but is not the one running now. Lower case.

eventBar.status.past.description: Small label beside the event's name on the Standings tab: the event has ended. Lower case.

eventBar.dates.description: Under the event's name on the Standings tab: the dates it runs from and to. {{start}} and {{end}} are dates such as "Mar 4, 2026", or a dash when unknown. Only the separator is translated.

eventBar.datesTakingPart_one.description: Under the event's name on the Standings tab: the dates it runs from and to, then how many people take part. {{start}} and {{end}} are dates such as "Mar 4, 2026", or a dash when unknown.

eventBar.datesTakingPart_other.description: Under the event's name on the Standings tab: the dates it runs from and to, then how many people take part. {{start}} and {{end}} are dates such as "Mar 4, 2026", or a dash when unknown.

eventBar.seasonNote.text: Whole-season standings: every public event in this season, combined. Pick a single event above to see just its results.
eventBar.seasonNote.description: Note on the Standings tab when the whole season is chosen in the event drop-down. "Above" is that drop-down.

eventBar.fallbackNote.text: Nothing is running right now, so this shows the most recent event.
eventBar.fallbackNote.description: Note on the Standings tab when no event is running and the last one that ended is shown instead.

challenges.loading.description: Accessible name of the grey placeholder shown on the Challenges tab while the challenges are being fetched.

challenges.empty.description: Shown on the Challenges tab when no challenge is running.

challenges.loadFailed.description: Error shown on the Challenges tab when the challenges could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

challenges.toFirst.description: Link on the Challenges tab for a new member looking at another event: switches to the event that holds their first challenges. "First challenges" is that group's name.

challenges.locked.notice.text: Finish Getting started to unlock the rest of the season.
challenges.locked.notice.description: Note under the list on the Challenges tab while the member's first challenges are unfinished. "Getting started" is the title of the card of first steps on Home.

challenges.points_one.description: What a challenge pays, on its card and page, and what a participant has earned in it. {{points}} is a number of points, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

challenges.points_other.description: What a challenge pays, on its card and page, and what a participant has earned in it. {{points}} is a number of points, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

challenges.soFar_one.description: On an unfinished challenge's page. {{points}} is the points the viewer has earned in it up to now, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

challenges.soFar_other.description: On an unfinished challenge's page. {{points}} is the points the viewer has earned in it up to now, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

challenges.state.done.description: Label in the progress bar of a challenge the viewer has finished.

challenges.state.started.description: Label in the progress bar of a challenge the viewer has begun, where no count can be shown.

challenges.state.notStarted.description: Label in the progress bar of a challenge the viewer has not begun.

challenges.state.named.description: Accessible name of a challenge's progress bar. {{challenge}} is the challenge's title and {{state}} what the bar shows ("Done", "3/5 changes").

challenges.rail.count.description: Label in the progress bar of a challenge counted in steps, e.g. "1/3 apps tried". {{current}} is how many the viewer has, {{target}} how many it takes, {{unit}} the organiser's own word for what is counted, shown as written.

challenges.rail.countThisWeek.description: Label in the progress bar of a weekly challenge counted in steps, e.g. "0/2 accepted this week"; the count starts again each Monday. {{current}} is how many the viewer has this week, {{target}} how many it takes, {{unit}} the organiser's own word for what is counted, shown as written.

challenges.rail.fraction.description: Label in the progress bar of a challenge counted in steps when the organiser named no unit, e.g. "1/3". {{current}} is how many the viewer has, {{target}} how many it takes.

challenges.rail.fractionThisWeek.description: Label in the progress bar of a weekly challenge counted in steps when the organiser named no unit, e.g. "0/2 this week"; the count starts again each Monday. {{current}} is how many the viewer has this week, {{target}} how many it takes.

challenges.heading.first.description: Heading over the Challenges tab's first group: the challenges a newcomer does first.

challenges.heading.next.description: Heading over the Challenges tab's group of every other challenge still open.

challenges.heading.done.description: Heading over the Challenges tab's last group: the challenges the viewer has finished.

challenges.locked.title_one.description: Title of the dashed card at the foot of the challenges list while the member's first steps are unfinished. {{count}} is how many challenges are still hidden. "Getting started" is the title of the card of first steps on Home.

challenges.locked.title_other.description: Title of the dashed card at the foot of the challenges list while the member's first steps are unfinished. {{count}} is how many challenges are still hidden. "Getting started" is the title of the card of first steps on Home.

challenges.locked.hint.text: Finish Getting started on Home to see them
challenges.locked.hint.description: Under the title of the locked-challenges card when the hidden challenges' names are not known. "Getting started" is the title of the card of first steps; "Home" is the Home screen.

challenges.locked.namesAnd.description: Under the title of the locked-challenges card: the names of the hidden challenges. {{names}} is all but the last name, already joined with commas, and {{last}} the last one.

challenges.locked.namesAndMore_one.description: Under the title of the locked-challenges card: the names of some hidden challenges, then how many more there are. {{names}} is the names, already joined with commas.

challenges.locked.namesAndMore_other.description: Under the title of the locked-challenges card: the names of some hidden challenges, then how many more there are. {{names}} is the names, already joined with commas.

progress.plainLabel_one.description: The summary over the Challenges tab's grid when the viewer's points are not known, and the accessible name of its progress bar. {{done}} is the number finished and {{count}} how many there are.

progress.plainLabel_other.description: The summary over the Challenges tab's grid when the viewer's points are not known, and the accessible name of its progress bar. {{done}} is the number finished and {{count}} how many there are.

progress.summary_one.description: The summary line over the Challenges tab's grid, e.g. "3,500 pts · 4 of 11 done". <0> wraps the points, drawn in bold. {{points}} is the viewer's points, already written out ("3,500 pts"); {{done}} is how many challenges they finished and {{count}} how many there are.

progress.summary_other.description: The summary line over the Challenges tab's grid, e.g. "3,500 pts · 4 of 11 done". <0> wraps the points, drawn in bold. {{points}} is the viewer's points, already written out ("3,500 pts"); {{done}} is how many challenges they finished and {{count}} how many there are.

challenges.detail.header.description: Title in the app's header while one challenge's page is open. A noun.

challenges.detail.headerFallback.description: Title in the app's header after a challenge's page is closed, when the screen's own title is not available.

challenges.detail.go.description: Button on a challenge's page that leads to where the challenge is done, when the challenge supplies no label of its own.

challenges.detail.linkUnavailable.description: On a challenge's page, in place of its button when the challenge's link cannot be used. {{label}} is the button's text; the note in the tag is shown in italics.

challenges.detail.seeFeedback.description: Link on the page of the feedback challenge: opens the list of feedback the viewer has sent.

challenges.detail.requirements.description: Heading on a challenge's page over the organiser's words on what counts towards it and how.

challenges.countNote.onPropose.text: Counts when you press Propose to group, which puts your change to a vote.
challenges.countNote.onPropose.description: Note on the page of a challenge that is completed by proposing a change. "Propose to group" is a button's label; "change" is a noun.

challenges.countNote.weekAccepted_one.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}} each week, and you have {{cap}} this week. More accepted changes this week don't add to it. It starts again on Monday.
challenges.countNote.weekAccepted_one.description: Note on the page of a weekly challenge about accepted changes once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "Changes" is a noun.

challenges.countNote.weekAccepted_other.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}} each week, and you have {{cap}} this week. More accepted changes this week don't add to it. It starts again on Monday.
challenges.countNote.weekAccepted_other.description: Note on the page of a weekly challenge about accepted changes once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "Changes" is a noun.

challenges.countNote.week_one.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}} each week, and you have {{cap}} this week. More this week don't add to it. It starts again on Monday.
challenges.countNote.week_one.description: Note on the page of a weekly challenge once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "More" means more of whatever the challenge counts.

challenges.countNote.week_other.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}} each week, and you have {{cap}} this week. More this week don't add to it. It starts again on Monday.
challenges.countNote.week_other.description: Note on the page of a weekly challenge once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "More" means more of whatever the challenge counts.

challenges.countNote.accepted_one.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}}, and you have {{cap}}. More accepted changes before it ends don't add to it.
challenges.countNote.accepted_one.description: Note on the page of a challenge about accepted changes once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "Changes" is a noun.

challenges.countNote.accepted_other.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}}, and you have {{cap}}. More accepted changes before it ends don't add to it.
challenges.countNote.accepted_other.description: Note on the page of a challenge about accepted changes once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "Changes" is a noun.

challenges.countNote.other_one.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}}, and you have {{cap}}. More before it ends don't add to it.
challenges.countNote.other_one.description: Note on the page of a challenge once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "More" means more of whatever the challenge counts.

challenges.countNote.other_other.text: This challenge counts up to {{cap}}, and you have {{cap}}. More before it ends don't add to it.
challenges.countNote.other_other.description: Note on the page of a challenge once the viewer has reached its limit. {{cap}} is the most the challenge counts, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural. "More" means more of whatever the challenge counts.

bp.checking.description: Shown on the block-production challenge's page while the viewer's wallet state is being fetched. "Block production" is running a node that produces blocks of the blockchain.

bp.error.title.text: Could not check your block-production status
bp.error.title.description: Title of the card on the block-production challenge's page when the viewer's wallet state could not be fetched.

bp.error.text.text: Check your connection and try again.
bp.error.text.description: Under "Could not check your block-production status" on the block-production challenge's page.

bp.error.retry.description: Button on the block-production challenge's page: fetches the viewer's wallet state again after it failed.

bp.account.title.description: Heading on the block-production challenge's page once the viewer has a wallet: there are two ways to take part.

bp.account.delegate.title.description: Title of the first option on the block-production challenge's page: hand the wallet's stake to the platform's server. "Delegate" is a verb.

bp.account.delegate.text.text: Your stake is delegated to Homeroom's block-production server, so nothing keeps running on your phone. When delegated, you receive half the points you would earn by producing blocks directly from your phone.
bp.account.delegate.text.description: Explanation of the "Delegate" option on the block-production challenge's page. Homeroom is the product's name.

bp.account.onDevice.title.text: Or produce blocks on this phone
bp.account.onDevice.title.description: Title of the second option on the block-production challenge's page, shown in the Android app.

bp.account.onDevice.text.text: Producing directly on this phone earns full points.
bp.account.onDevice.text.description: Explanation of the "Or produce blocks on this phone" option on the block-production challenge's page.

bp.account.onDevice.warning.text: Only for phones that can stay on. A background service keeps running with a persistent notification, it uses more battery and data, and Android must let the app run unrestricted in the background and set exact alarms. If the phone stops the app, it misses its slots.
bp.account.onDevice.warning.description: Warning under the "Or produce blocks on this phone" option on the block-production challenge's page. "Slots" are the moments at which the phone must produce a block. Android is the operating system's name.

bp.account.onDeviceNote.text: Producing blocks on the phone itself is available only in the Android app.
bp.account.onDeviceNote.description: Note on the block-production challenge's page where producing on the device is not offered. Android is the operating system's name.

bp.account.manage.description: Button on the block-production challenge's page: opens the wallet, where the stake is delegated or taken back.

bp.account.appNote.text: Delegation is managed from the wallet in the Homeroom app. If it is not offered there yet, update the app.
bp.account.appNote.description: Note on the block-production challenge's page, inside the Homeroom app, when this version of the app cannot manage delegation. Homeroom is the product's name.

bp.account.webNote.text: Delegation is managed from your wallet in the Homeroom app. Open this challenge there.
bp.account.webNote.description: Note on the block-production challenge's page in a web browser. "Open" is a verb. Homeroom is the product's name.

bp.pending.title.description: Title of the card on the block-production challenge's page after the viewer asked for a wallet and is waiting for it.

bp.pending.text.text: An admin releases wallet keys in batches. Once yours are released, come back here to choose how your blocks are produced.
bp.pending.text.description: Under "Wallet requested" on the block-production challenge's page.

bp.locked.title.description: Title of the card on the block-production challenge's page for an account that may not request a wallet yet.

bp.locked.text.text: You can request a wallet once your account has platform access.
bp.locked.text.description: Under "Not available yet" on the block-production challenge's page. "Platform access" is what an account has once it is let in from the waitlist.

bp.request.title.description: Title of the card on the block-production challenge's page for a viewer who has no wallet. "Request" is a verb.

bp.request.text.text: Producing blocks needs a wallet with producer keys. Ask for one and an admin will release your keys in batches.
bp.request.text.description: Under "First, request a wallet" on the block-production challenge's page.

bp.request.action.description: Button on the block-production challenge's page: asks the administrators for a wallet. "Request" is a verb.

bp.request.pending.description: Shown on the "Request a wallet" button of the block-production challenge's page while the request is being sent.

bp.request.sent.text: Request sent. An admin will release your keys
bp.request.sent.description: Brief message shown after the viewer asked for a wallet on the block-production challenge's page. "Request" is a noun.

bp.request.failed.description: Brief message shown when asking for a wallet on the block-production challenge's page failed and the server gave no reason. "Request" is a noun.

standing.label.description: Accessible name of the card at the top of the Challenges tab that shows the viewer's rank and points this season.

standing.rankOf_one.description: The "Your standing" card at the top of the Challenges tab, e.g. "#22 of 161 people". <0> wraps the viewer's place, drawn large. {{rank}} is the place, {{number}} how many people the standings rank, already formatted ("1,284"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

standing.rankOf_other.description: The "Your standing" card at the top of the Challenges tab, e.g. "#22 of 161 people". <0> wraps the viewer's place, drawn large. {{rank}} is the place, {{number}} how many people the standings rank, already formatted ("1,284"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural.

standing.rank.description: The "Your standing" card's place when the number of people ranked is not known, e.g. "#22". <0> wraps it, drawn large. {{rank}} is the place.

standing.yourStanding.description: On the "Your standing" card, in place of the rank, when the viewer has points the ranking does not show yet.

standing.pending_one.text: {{points}} pts earned, not in the standings yet
standing.pending_one.description: On the "Your standing" card when the viewer has earned points that the ranking does not show yet. {{points}} is a number, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

standing.pending_other.text: {{points}} pts earned, not in the standings yet
standing.pending_other.description: On the "Your standing" card when the viewer has earned points that the ranking does not show yet. {{points}} is a number, already formatted ("1,500"); {{count}} is the same number, for the plural; "pts" abbreviates points.

standing.token.withheld.description: Heading on the "Your standing" card when the viewer has not accepted the program's terms, so their share of tokens is not shown.

standing.token.review.text: Review and accept the terms to see your token allocation.
standing.token.review.description: Under "Token allocation withheld" on the "Your standing" card.

standing.token.reviewTerms.description: Button on the "Your standing" card: opens the program's terms to read and accept.

standing.token.label.description: Label on the "Your standing" card beside the number of tokens allotted to the viewer.

standing.token.note.text: Your share of the season’s token pool. Allocations are provisional and subject to the program terms.
standing.token.note.description: Note under the token allocation on the "Your standing" card.

standing.token.reveal.description: Button on the "Your standing" card: shows the token amount, which is blurred until pressed.

standings.loading.description: Accessible name of the grey placeholder shown on the Standings tab while the ranking is being fetched.

standings.loadFailed.description: Error shown on the Standings tab when the ranking could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

standings.noEvents.text: No events have been published yet.
standings.noEvents.description: Shown on the Standings tab when there is no event at all.

standings.noData.description: Shown on the Standings tab when the server returned nothing for the chosen event.

standings.private.text: The leaderboard for this event isn't public yet.
standings.private.description: Shown on the Standings tab for an event whose ranking the organisers have not opened.

standings.noEntries.text: No leaderboard entries yet. Standings update every few hours; points from challenges you just finished appear at the next update.
standings.noEntries.description: Shown on the Standings tab when nobody is ranked yet.

standings.allExcluded.text: Everyone with a score on this board is excluded from the ranking.
standings.allExcluded.description: Shown on the Standings tab when every participant is marked non-podium, so the ranked list is empty.

standings.challengesDone_one.description: Line at the top of the Standings tab for a signed-in viewer: how many of the event's challenges they have finished, then a link to the Challenges tab. {{done}} is the number finished and {{count}} the total. The first tag holds the separator, in lighter ink; the second is the link. Keep the arrow.

standings.challengesDone_other.description: Line at the top of the Standings tab for a signed-in viewer: how many of the event's challenges they have finished, then a link to the Challenges tab. {{done}} is the number finished and {{count}} the total. The first tag holds the separator, in lighter ink; the second is the link. Keep the arrow.

standings.viewChallenges.description: Line at the top of the Standings tab for a viewer who is not signed in: a link to the Challenges tab. The first tag holds a separator, in lighter ink; the second is the link. Keep the arrow.

standings.showNonPodium.description: Filter chip on the Standings tab: also lists participants who are excluded from the prize ranking.

standings.showNonPodiumCount_one.description: Filter chip on the Standings tab: also lists participants who are excluded from the prize ranking. {{count}} is how many there are.

standings.showNonPodiumCount_other.description: Filter chip on the Standings tab: also lists participants who are excluded from the prize ranking. {{count}} is how many there are.

standings.column.rank.description: Column heading in the Standings table: a participant's position.

standings.column.user.description: Column heading in the Standings table: the participant's name.

standings.column.points.description: Column heading in the Standings table for one event.

standings.column.seasonPoints.description: Column heading in the Standings table when the whole season is shown.

standings.column.blocks.description: Column heading in the Standings table: how many blocks of the blockchain the participant's node produced.

standings.column.success.description: Column heading in the Standings table: the share of the participant's won slots in which a block was produced.

standings.anonymous.description: Stands in for a participant's name in the Standings table, and over their details, when they have no public name.

standings.nonPodium.description: A participant's cell in the Standings table, for somebody who takes part but is excluded from the prize ranking. {{name}} is their name, in the first tag; the note in the second tag is shown smaller, in lighter ink.

standings.nonPodiumTip.description: Tooltip of the "non-podium" note beside a participant's name in the Standings table.

standings.openDetails.description: Accessible name of a row in the Standings table: pressing it shows that participant's activities. "Open" is a verb. {{name}} is the participant's name.

standings.openDetailsAnonymous.description: Accessible name of a row in the Standings table: pressing it shows that participant's activities. "Open" is a verb. Used for a person with no display name, who is listed as "Anonymous".

standings.page_one.description: Under the Standings table: which page is shown, how many pages there are, and how many participants in all.

standings.page_other.description: Under the Standings table: which page is shown, how many pages there are, and how many participants in all.

standings.prev.description: Button under the Standings table: shows the previous page. Short for "previous".

standings.next.description: Button under the Standings table: shows the next page.

drill.activities.description: Heading in a participant's details under the Standings table, over the list of things they earned points for.

drill.activitiesLoading.description: Shown in a participant's details under the Standings table while their activities are being fetched.

drill.activitiesEmpty.text: No activities recorded for this event.
drill.activitiesEmpty.description: Shown in a participant's details under the Standings table when nothing they did in the event is recorded.

drill.activitiesFailed.description: Error shown in a participant's details under the Standings table when their activities could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

drill.noIdentifier.text: No identifier available for this row.
drill.noIdentifier.description: Shown in place of a participant's activities under the Standings table when the row carries nothing to look them up by.

drill.epoch.heading.description: Heading in a participant's details under the Standings table, over their block production epoch by epoch. An epoch is a fixed period of the network's time.

drill.epoch.loading.description: Shown in a participant's details under the Standings table while their epoch-by-epoch record is being fetched.

drill.epoch.empty.text: No epoch data for this event.
drill.epoch.empty.description: Shown in a participant's details under the Standings table when there is no epoch-by-epoch record.

drill.epoch.failed.text: Could not load the epoch breakdown.
drill.epoch.failed.description: Error shown in a participant's details under the Standings table when their epoch-by-epoch record could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

drill.epoch.perEvent.text: The epoch breakdown is per event. Pick a single event above to see it.
drill.epoch.perEvent.description: Shown in a participant's details under the Standings table when the whole season is chosen. "Above" is the event drop-down.

drill.epoch.noWallet.text: No wallet linked for this row.
drill.epoch.noWallet.description: Shown in place of the epoch-by-epoch record under the Standings table when the participant has no wallet address.

drill.epoch.column.epoch.description: Column heading in the epoch-by-epoch table of a participant's details: the epoch's number.

drill.epoch.column.wonSlots.description: Column heading in the epoch-by-epoch table of a participant's details: block-producing slots won in that epoch.

drill.epoch.column.produced.description: Column heading in the epoch-by-epoch table of a participant's details: blocks produced in that epoch.

drill.epoch.column.successRate.description: Column heading in the epoch-by-epoch table of a participant's details: the share of won slots in which a block was produced.

drill.profile.heading.description: Heading in the viewer's own details under the Standings table, over their figures for the event.

drill.profile.loading.description: Shown in the viewer's own details under the Standings table while their figures are being fetched.

drill.profile.failed.description: Error shown in the viewer's own details under the Standings table when their figures could not be fetched and the server gave no reason.

drill.profile.rank.description: Label of a figure in the viewer's own details under the Standings table: their position in the ranking.

drill.profile.totalPoints.description: Label of a figure in the viewer's own details under the Standings table.

drill.profile.producedBlocks.description: Label of a figure in the viewer's own details under the Standings table: blocks their node produced.

drill.profile.clientRate.description: Label of a figure in the viewer's own details under the Standings table: the success rate as their own app reported it.

drill.profile.canonicalRate.description: Label of a figure in the viewer's own details under the Standings table: the success rate as the blockchain itself records it.

activity.dayTime.description: Under an activity in a participant's list: when it happened. {{day}} is a date such as "Mon, Oct 12" and {{time}} a time of day. Only the separator is translated.

activity.dayTimeFull.description: Tooltip of an activity's date in a participant's list. {{day}} is a full date such as "Monday, October 12, 2026" and {{time}} a time of day. Only the separator is translated.

activity.gradeReason.description: Under a graded activity in a participant's list on the Leaderboard: why it earned the points it did. {{reason}} is the grader's short explanation, shown as written.

kudos.loading.description: Accessible name of the grey placeholder shown on the Kudos tab while a list is being fetched.

kudos.tab.changes.description: Sub-tab of the Kudos tab: the changes that received the most kudos. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.tab.users.description: Sub-tab of the Kudos tab: the people whose changes received the most kudos.

kudos.tab.history.description: Sub-tab of the Kudos tab: the kudos and votes the viewer has given.

kudos.window.all.description: Filter on the Kudos tab: count kudos since the beginning.

kudos.window.week.description: Filter on the Kudos tab: count only this week's kudos.

kudos.subtitle_one.text: {{count}} kudos per week, resets {{day}} at {{time}}. Give them to changes you appreciate.
kudos.subtitle_one.description: Line at the top of the Kudos tab. {{count}} is how many kudos each member may give per week; the middle part says when that allowance starts again. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM". "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.subtitle_other.text: {{count}} kudos per week, resets {{day}} at {{time}}. Give them to changes you appreciate.
kudos.subtitle_other.description: Line at the top of the Kudos tab. {{count}} is how many kudos each member may give per week; the middle part says when that allowance starts again. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM". "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.subtitleUtc_one.text: {{count}} kudos per week, resets Monday 00:00 UTC. Give them to changes you appreciate.
kudos.subtitleUtc_one.description: Line at the top of the Kudos tab when the reset time cannot be shown in the viewer's own time zone. {{count}} is how many kudos each member may give per week. Keep "00:00 UTC". "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.subtitleUtc_other.text: {{count}} kudos per week, resets Monday 00:00 UTC. Give them to changes you appreciate.
kudos.subtitleUtc_other.description: Line at the top of the Kudos tab when the reset time cannot be shown in the viewer's own time zone. {{count}} is how many kudos each member may give per week. Keep "00:00 UTC". "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.historySubtitle.text: Everything you’ve given: kudos, bounty pledges, and votes, newest first. Only you can see this.
kudos.historySubtitle.description: Line at the top of the Kudos tab's "My history" sub-tab. A "bounty pledge" is kudos promised to whoever fulfils a request.

kudos.loadFailed.text: Couldn’t load leaderboard. Try again later.
kudos.loadFailed.description: Error shown on the Kudos tab when a ranking could not be fetched.

kudos.rankNote.text: Ranks update live as people give kudos and changes go live, so yours can move even when you did nothing.
kudos.rankNote.description: Small note under the ranked list on the Kudos tab's "Top changes" and "Top users" sub-tabs: why a rank can move without the viewer doing anything. "Changes" is a noun; "live" is an adjective, as in the lists' status labels.

kudos.empty.changes.text: No kudos yet. When someone gives a change kudos, it shows up here.
kudos.empty.changes.description: Shown on the Kudos tab's "Top changes" list, all-time, when it is empty. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.empty.changesWeek.text: No kudos this week yet. When someone gives a change kudos, it shows up here.
kudos.empty.changesWeek.description: Shown on the Kudos tab's "Top changes" list, this week, when it is empty. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.empty.users.text: No kudos yet. When someone gets kudos on a change they made, they show up here.
kudos.empty.users.description: Shown on the Kudos tab's "Top users" list, all-time, when it is empty. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.empty.usersWeek.text: No kudos this week yet. When someone gets kudos on a change they made, they show up here.
kudos.empty.usersWeek.description: Shown on the Kudos tab's "Top users" list, this week, when it is empty. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.loadMore.description: Button under a list on the Kudos tab: fetches the next page.

kudos.loadingMore.description: Shown on the "Load more" button of the Kudos tab while the next page is being fetched.

kudos.untitledChange.description: Stands in for a change's title in the lists of the Kudos tab when it has none. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.unnamedApp.description: Stands in for an app's name in the lists of the Kudos tab when it is not known. Lower case.

kudos.unknownUser.description: Stands in for a username in the lists of the Kudos tab when it is not known. It is shown after an @ sign, as "@unknown", so keep it one lower-case word.

kudos.row.by.description: Under a change's title in the Kudos tab's lists: who made it. Keep the @ before the username.

kudos.row.byUnknown.description: Under a change's title in the Kudos tab's lists: who made it. Keep the @ before the username. Used when the author is not known; "@unknown" is written as the row has always shown it.

kudos.row.byDeleted.description: Under a change's title in the Kudos tab's "My history" list when its author's account no longer exists. Keep the @.

kudos.status.live.description: Small status label on a change in the Kudos tab's lists: it was approved and is running. Lower case; an adjective.

kudos.status.goingLive.description: Small status label on a change in the Kudos tab's lists: it was approved and is being put into the running project. Lower case.

kudos.status.closed.description: Small status label on a change in the Kudos tab's lists: it ended without going live. Lower case; an adjective.

kudos.status.open.description: Small status label on a change in the Kudos tab's lists: it is still being worked on or voted on. Lower case; an adjective.

kudos.user.changesKudosed_one.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many of their changes received kudos. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.user.changesKudosed_other.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many of their changes received kudos. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.user.live_one.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many of their changes are running. An adjective.

kudos.user.live_other.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many of their changes are running. An adjective.

kudos.user.issues_one.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many requests (issues) they have filed.

kudos.user.issues_other.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many requests (issues) they have filed.

kudos.user.activeOn_one.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many apps they have recently worked on. Lower case.

kudos.user.activeOn_other.description: Under a person's name in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many apps they have recently worked on. Lower case.

kudos.user.activeOnTip.description: Tooltip of "active on N apps" in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{apps}} is the list of those apps' names, already joined.

kudos.user.notLiveYet_one.description: At the right of a person's row in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many kudos they received on changes that are not running yet. Keep the + sign.

kudos.user.notLiveYet_other.description: At the right of a person's row in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. {{count}} is how many kudos they received on changes that are not running yet. Keep the + sign.

kudos.user.notLiveTip.text: Kudos on changes that aren’t live yet, not counted toward ranking
kudos.user.notLiveTip.description: Tooltip of "+N not live yet" in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.user.earnedTip.description: Tooltip of the kudos count at the right of a person's row in the Kudos tab's "Top users" list. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.back.description: Link at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab: returns to the "Top users" list. Keep the arrow.

kudos.person.intro.text: All changes this user has proposed, newest first.
kudos.person.intro.description: Under a person's name on their page on the Kudos tab. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.notFound.description: Shown on the Kudos tab when the person whose page was opened does not exist.

kudos.person.loadFailed.text: Couldn’t load this profile. Try again later.
kudos.person.loadFailed.description: Error shown on the Kudos tab when a person's page could not be fetched.

kudos.person.onLive_one.description: Chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab, after a clapping-hands emoji. {{count}} is how many kudos they received on changes that are running. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.onLive_other.description: Chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab, after a clapping-hands emoji. {{count}} is how many kudos they received on changes that are running. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.onLiveTip.text: Kudos earned on live changes: the leaderboard ranking score
kudos.person.onLiveTip.description: Tooltip of the kudos chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.live_one.description: Chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab. {{count}} is how many of their changes are running. An adjective.

kudos.person.live_other.description: Chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab. {{count}} is how many of their changes are running. An adjective.

kudos.person.liveTip.description: Tooltip of the "N live" chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.made_one.description: Chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab. {{count}} is how many changes they have proposed in all. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.person.made_other.description: Chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab. {{count}} is how many changes they have proposed in all. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.person.madeTip.text: Everything they put up for the group, including open and closed changes
kudos.person.madeTip.description: Tooltip of the "N changes made" chip at the top of a person's page on the Kudos tab. "Open" and "closed" are adjectives; "changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.none.description: Shown on a person's page on the Kudos tab when they have proposed nothing. "Changes" is a noun.

kudos.person.openOnGithub.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the ↗ link on a change in a person's page on the Kudos tab: opens the change on GitHub. "Open" is a verb.

kudos.history.filterKudos.description: Filter chip on the Kudos tab's "My history" list: shows or hides the kudos the viewer gave. Keep the emoji.

kudos.history.filterVotes.description: Filter chip on the Kudos tab's "My history" list: shows or hides the votes the viewer cast. Keep the emoji.

kudos.history.loadFailed.text: Couldn’t load your history. Try again later.
kudos.history.loadFailed.description: Error shown on the Kudos tab's "My history" list when it could not be fetched.

kudos.history.empty.text: Nothing here yet. Kudos, bounty pledges, and votes you give will appear here.
kudos.history.empty.description: Shown on the Kudos tab's "My history" list when it is empty. A "bounty pledge" is kudos promised to whoever fulfils a request.

kudos.history.bounty.description: Small label on a row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the viewer pledged kudos as a bounty on a request. Lower case; a noun.

kudos.history.yes.description: Small label on a row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the viewer voted yes on a change. Lower case.

kudos.history.no.description: Small label on a row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the viewer voted no on a change. Lower case.

kudos.history.pledged.description: Title of a row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the viewer promised kudos to whoever fulfils a request. {{number}} is the request's number, or "?" when unknown.

kudos.history.awardedTo.description: Small label on a bounty row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the pledged kudos went to this person on this date. {{date}} is a date such as "Mar 4, 2026". Keep the @ before the username. Lower case.

kudos.history.awardedToUndated.description: Small label on a bounty row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the pledged kudos went to this person; the date is not known. Keep the @ before the username. Lower case.

kudos.history.awardedToDeleted.description: Small label on a bounty row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the pledged kudos went to a person whose account no longer exists. {{date}} is a date such as "Mar 4, 2026". Lower case.

kudos.history.awardedToDeletedUndated.description: Small label on a bounty row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the pledged kudos went to a person whose account no longer exists; the date is not known. Lower case.

kudos.history.voided.description: Small label on a bounty row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the pledge was cancelled and returned. Lower case.

kudos.history.voidedTip.text: Your own change closed this request, so the pledge went back to your weekly allowance
kudos.history.voidedTip.description: Tooltip of the "voided" label on a bounty row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list. "Change" and "request" are nouns.

kudos.history.open.description: Small label on a bounty row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the pledge is still waiting to be awarded. Lower case; an adjective.

kudos.history.currentVote.description: Small italic note on a vote row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the row shows the viewer's vote as it stands now. Lower case.

kudos.history.request.description: Stands in for the title of a community decision in the Kudos tab's "My history" list when it has none. {{number}} is its number, or "?" when unknown. "Request" is a noun.

kudos.history.kind.secretChange.description: Small label on a vote row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the decision was about changing a secret (a stored key or password) of the project. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.history.kind.rename.description: Small label on a vote row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the decision was about renaming the project. A noun.

kudos.history.kind.closeIssue.description: Small label on a vote row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the decision was about closing a request. "Close" is a verb.

kudos.history.kind.maintenance.description: Small label on a vote row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the decision was about starting a round of maintenance work on the project.

kudos.history.kind.featuredIllustration.description: Small label on a vote row of the Kudos tab's "My history" list: the decision was about the picture shown for the project where it is featured.

kudos.button.collaboratorsOnly.description: Tooltip of a disabled kudos button on a change, for a viewer who is not a collaborator on the project.

kudos.button.ownChange.text: You can’t give kudos to your own change
kudos.button.ownChange.description: Tooltip of a disabled kudos button on a change the viewer made. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.button.viaBounty.text: Credited via a bounty award, so it can’t be retracted
kudos.button.viaBounty.description: Tooltip of a kudos button the viewer cannot undo, because their kudos came from a bounty they pledged.

kudos.button.retract.text: You gave kudos to this change. Click again to retract
kudos.button.retract.description: Tooltip of a kudos button the viewer has already pressed. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.button.thank.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the kudos button on a change that is up for a vote. {{username}} is the author of the change. "Putting this up" means proposing it to the group.

kudos.button.thankFace.description: Text on the kudos button of a change that is up for a vote. {{username}} is the author of the change. The part in the tag is dropped when the button is narrow, so the words before it must make sense alone.

kudos.popover.none.text: No kudos yet. Be the first.
kudos.popover.none.description: Shown in the pop-up of a kudos button when nobody has given the change kudos.

kudos.popover.loading.description: Shown in the pop-up of a kudos button while the list of givers is being fetched.

kudos.popover.givers_one.description: Heading of the pop-up of a kudos button, over the list of people who gave the change kudos. {{count}} is how many.

kudos.popover.givers_other.description: Heading of the pop-up of a kudos button, over the list of people who gave the change kudos. {{count}} is how many.

kudos.popover.failed.description: Shown in the pop-up of a kudos button when the list of givers could not be fetched.

kudos.popover.someone.description: Stands in for a giver's username in the pop-up of a kudos button when it is not known. It is shown after an @ sign, as "@someone", so keep it one lower-case word.

kudos.popover.you.description: Stands in for the viewer's own username in the pop-up of a kudos button, just after they gave kudos, when their username is not known. It is shown after an @ sign, as "@you", so keep it one lower-case word.

kudos.toast.quota.description: Brief message shown when giving kudos was refused because the viewer has none left this week, and the server gave no wording.

kudos.toast.ownChange.text: You can’t give kudos to your own change.
kudos.toast.ownChange.description: Brief message shown when the viewer tried to give kudos to a change they made. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.toast.already.text: You already gave kudos to this change.
kudos.toast.already.description: Brief message shown when the viewer tried to give kudos to a change twice. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.toast.notEligible.text: This change isn’t eligible for kudos.
kudos.toast.notEligible.description: Brief message shown when a change cannot receive kudos and the server gave no wording. "Change" is a noun.

kudos.toast.giveFailed.text: Failed to give kudos. Try again?
kudos.toast.giveFailed.description: Brief message shown when giving kudos failed for an unknown reason.

kudos.toast.giveNetwork.description: Brief message shown when giving kudos failed because the server could not be reached.

kudos.toast.nothingToRetract.description: Brief message shown when the viewer tried to take back kudos they had not given, and the server gave no wording.

kudos.toast.retractFailed.text: Failed to retract kudos. Try again?
kudos.toast.retractFailed.description: Brief message shown when taking kudos back failed for an unknown reason.

kudos.toast.retractNetwork.description: Brief message shown when taking kudos back failed because the server could not be reached.

kudos.budget.left_one.description: The viewer's weekly kudos allowance, in the menu: {{remaining}} of the {{count}} kudos they may give this week are left. The first tag wraps one figure with its words, the second shows the number in strong ink and the third the words in dim ink.

kudos.budget.left_other.description: The viewer's weekly kudos allowance, in the menu: {{remaining}} of the {{count}} kudos they may give this week are left. The first tag wraps one figure with its words, the second shows the number in strong ink and the third the words in dim ink.

kudos.budget.thanksBounties_one.description: The viewer's two weekly allowances, in the menu: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks (kudos) left, then {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties left. The first tag wraps one figure with its words, the second shows the number in strong ink and the third the words in dim ink. The fourth holds the separator, in dim ink.

kudos.budget.thanksBounties_other.description: The viewer's two weekly allowances, in the menu: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks (kudos) left, then {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties left. The first tag wraps one figure with its words, the second shows the number in strong ink and the third the words in dim ink. The fourth holds the separator, in dim ink.

kudos.budget.tip_one.text: {{remaining}} of {{count}} kudos left this week. Resets {{day}} at {{time}} ({{utc}}).
kudos.budget.tip_one.description: Tooltip of the weekly kudos allowance in the menu. {{remaining}} of the {{count}} kudos are left; the second sentence says when the allowance starts again. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM". {{utc}} is the same moment in UTC, already formatted, for example "Mon, Oct 5, 00:00 UTC".

kudos.budget.tip_other.text: {{remaining}} of {{count}} kudos left this week. Resets {{day}} at {{time}} ({{utc}}).
kudos.budget.tip_other.description: Tooltip of the weekly kudos allowance in the menu. {{remaining}} of the {{count}} kudos are left; the second sentence says when the allowance starts again. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM". {{utc}} is the same moment in UTC, already formatted, for example "Mon, Oct 5, 00:00 UTC".

kudos.budget.tipUtc_one.text: {{remaining}} of {{count}} kudos left this week. Resets Monday 00:00 UTC.
kudos.budget.tipUtc_one.description: Tooltip of the weekly kudos allowance in the menu when the reset time cannot be shown in the viewer's own time zone. {{remaining}} of the {{count}} kudos are left. Keep "00:00 UTC".

kudos.budget.tipUtc_other.text: {{remaining}} of {{count}} kudos left this week. Resets Monday 00:00 UTC.
kudos.budget.tipUtc_other.description: Tooltip of the weekly kudos allowance in the menu when the reset time cannot be shown in the viewer's own time zone. {{remaining}} of the {{count}} kudos are left. Keep "00:00 UTC".

kudos.budget.tipBounties_one.text: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks and {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties left this week. Resets {{day}} at {{time}} ({{utc}}).
kudos.budget.tipBounties_one.description: Tooltip of the two weekly allowances in the menu: thanks (kudos) and bounties. {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks and {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties are left; the second sentence says when both start again. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM". {{utc}} is the same moment in UTC, already formatted, for example "Mon, Oct 5, 00:00 UTC".

kudos.budget.tipBounties_other.text: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks and {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties left this week. Resets {{day}} at {{time}} ({{utc}}).
kudos.budget.tipBounties_other.description: Tooltip of the two weekly allowances in the menu: thanks (kudos) and bounties. {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks and {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties are left; the second sentence says when both start again. {{day}} is the weekday's full name and {{time}} the time of day, both in the person's own clock and format, for example "Sunday" and "8:00 PM". {{utc}} is the same moment in UTC, already formatted, for example "Mon, Oct 5, 00:00 UTC".

kudos.budget.tipBountiesUtc_one.text: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks and {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties left this week. Resets Monday 00:00 UTC.
kudos.budget.tipBountiesUtc_one.description: Tooltip of the two weekly allowances in the menu, thanks (kudos) and bounties, when the reset time cannot be shown in the viewer's own time zone. Keep "00:00 UTC".

kudos.budget.tipBountiesUtc_other.text: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} thanks and {{bountiesRemaining}} of {{count}} bounties left this week. Resets Monday 00:00 UTC.
kudos.budget.tipBountiesUtc_other.description: Tooltip of the two weekly allowances in the menu, thanks (kudos) and bounties, when the reset time cannot be shown in the viewer's own time zone. Keep "00:00 UTC".

kudos.status.goingLiveTitle.description: Tooltip on the "going live" status label of a change of Homeroom itself, in the Kudos tab's lists. {{release}} is a finished sentence saying when the change goes live, for example "Merged; goes live in the next release (about 8 minutes)"; this entry adds only the full stop that ends it.
